title: UTMB 2026 — Race Profile / Map / Timing Table (2026-11-08 recheck: 17 rows, 173.6 km / +9,700 m)
claims: The official interactive track view is the public source for the 2026 UTMB profile, map and timing table.
The profile covers the full 2026 course from Chamonix back to Chamonix.

The 2026 timing table has 17 rows and totals 173.6 km with +9,700 m and −9,699 m. Row by row it gives: Chamonix start 0 km, 1,035 m, +0/−0; Saint-Gervais 22.9 km, 809 m, +1,040/−1,267; Les Contamines Montjoie 32.4 km, 1,147 m, +1,535/−158; La Balme 41.1 km, 1,706 m, +2,130/−34; Les Chapieux 52.2 km, 1,546 m, +2,924/−954; Lac Combal 67.8 km, 1,965 m, +3,977/−634; Checrouit–Maison Vieille 76.4 km, 1,961 m, +4,455/−482; Courmayeur Sport Center Sortie 81.3 km, 1,194 m, +4,475/−785; Refuge Bertone 86.6 km, 1,979 m, +5,288/−31; Arnouvaz 99.4 km, 1,779 m, +5,727/−636; La Fouly 114.0 km, 1,604 m, +6,574/−1,024; Champex-Lac sortie 127.5 km, 1,472 m, +7,086/−645; Plan de l'Au 132.4 km, 1,340 m, +7,165/−210; Trient 144.0 km, 1,303 m, +7,943/−817; Vallorcine Sortie 155.3 km, 1,260 m, +8,734/−834; La Flégère 166.6 km, 1,883 m, +9,687/−327; Chamonix finish 173.6 km, 1,036 m, +9,700/−861.

The services column is icon-only with no text labels or alt text. The icons on each row are: Chamonix start medical + bus; Saint-Gervais food + Näak + medical + bus + WC; Les Contamines two-hands + food + Näak + medical + bus + WC; La Balme medical + WC; Les Chapieux hot food + Näak + medical + bus + WC + bed; Lac Combal food + Näak + medical + bus + WC; Checrouit–Maison Vieille water + WC; Courmayeur two-hands + hot food + Näak + medical + bus + drop bag + WC + bed; Refuge Bertone water + Näak + WC + charging; Arnouvaz food + Näak + medical + bus + WC; La Fouly food + Näak + medical + bus + WC; Champex-Lac two-hands + hot food + Näak + medical + bus + drop bag + WC + bed; Plan de l'Au no icons; Trient food + Näak + medical + bus + WC; Vallorcine two-hands + food + Näak + medical + bus + WC; La Flégère water + Näak + medical + WC; Chamonix finish hot food + medical + bus + WC + shower + bed.

On 2026-11-08 the rendered page did not include a 32-point table or any text naming Col des Pyramides Calcaires.
